Discovery and planning+

Understand the work before committing to a build. In 1-2 weeks, explore practical recommendations and working proofs of concept.

Huru Lab Espresso Bar+

At the end of discovery, a half-day to full-day working session brings the findings and possible next steps to life.

Custom AI tools+

Build around your actual needs, with experienced engineers planning, reviewing and taking responsibility for the software.

Workflow automation+

Connect repetitive steps using existing tools or custom software. Choose the smallest useful intervention.

Websites and online presence+

New websites, rebuilds, SEO and localization. We walk through what your customers need, including where AI features would add little.

Data analysis and reports+

Connect collection, analysis and reporting so information reaches the people who need to make a decision.

Private and on-prem AI+

Explore local or private deployment when your data calls for it. We help assess cost, capability and practical tradeoffs.

Training+

Learn through your team’s own tasks: what can be delegated, what needs review and where human judgment matters.

Ongoing support+

Keep useful tools working as your business and AI capabilities change. We revisit new pain points with you.

A few things
you might be wondering.

Do we definitely need AI?+

Maybe. Discovery can also point to clearer processes, better software or a simpler website. If you do not need AI, we will tell you.

Will this become another task for our team?+

The goal is to remove friction inside the work you already do. We design the review and approval steps around your team.

Are we committed to a full build?+

No. Discovery is a short, defined piece of work that helps you decide what is worth building. You choose how to continue.
